checks.name: initial
checks.coverage: 134 edges for each of two opposite-clock DUT instances, capture and between-edge hold

limitations: Development verification is not official evaluation; official correctness remains unevaluated.
Original specification provides no reset or power-up output value; output checks begin after the first intentional edge.
Tests use stable binary data and clock signals and settled output sampling; setup/hold violations, unknown clock transitions, and physical glitches are outside the specified behavior.
implementation: Separate rising-edge and falling-edge sample registers with clock-controlled output selection; no extra ports or clock latency.
